content.title: Storm-Cliff Activation | Raised Hand, White Vortex and Brightened Portrait
content.summary: An adult wind keeper releases white feather lights that scale into three sky birds. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity, costume and platform remain stable. + One accent color carries every activation stage. + A single gesture visibly precedes all supernatural effects. + Scale grows from flare to feathers to large birds without a world reset. + The environment clears and the original subject returns after release.
quick_start.recommended_input: Begin on one original adult wind keeper in an ivory robe, face calm under charcoal storm clouds. The keeper raises the right arm once; one white flare opens behind the shoulder and no other color activates. Open one clear corridor in the clouds, dissolve the birds into soft feathers and end on the same adult keeper in calm three-quarter view.
required_anchors: One adult identity, costume and platform remain stable.
One accent color carries every activation stage.
Scale grows from flare to feathers to large birds without a world reset.
The environment clears and the original subject returns after release.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult wind keeper releases white feather lights that scale into three sky birds. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.

Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 同一成年角色在灰黑风暴崖顶保持身份与白衣锚点；一次抬臂动作先产生局部背光，再扩展为可数羽光和巨型白鸟旋涡，最终云层打开并回到平静人物近景。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One adult identity, costume and platform remain stable.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult identity, costume and platform remain stable."

invariants.rule: One accent color carries every activation stage.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "One accent color carries every activation stage."

invariants.rule: A single gesture visibly precedes all supernatural effects.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "A single gesture visibly precedes all supernatural effects."

invariants.rule: Scale grows from flare to feathers to large birds without a world reset.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Scale grows from flare to feathers to large birds without a world reset."

invariants.rule: The environment clears and the original subject returns after release.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The environment clears and the original subject returns after release."
